## Human Review

**What changed and why:** Describe the problem and resulting behavior or document change.

**How the owner can verify it:** Give concrete actions and expected results, linking to product criteria.

**Remaining limitations, risks, or owner decisions:** Distinguish proposals from approved or implemented behavior.

**Third-party materials:** Identify new dependencies/assets/code, source and license records, or state none. Disclose unresolved rights questions.

## Technical Verification

**Revision and actual checks/results:** Record commands and outcomes for the delivered revision, including skipped or failed checks.

**CI and review status:** Link observed runs/reviews or mark them unavailable/unverified. Describe substantive findings and fixes. Keep human acceptance and merge authorization separate.
